summary: Fixed bounded-shape sterility as absence of any interior triple t,u,v≥2 with tuv−u−v=p. Exact enumeration for all 147 primes p≡1 (mod 4), p≤2000, found triples for 146 and none only at p=5; this finite search found no larger sterile prime. It does not certify CRT classes or moduli up to 10⁶.

summary: Implemented the Ozsváth–Szabó lens recursion with exact rational arithmetic and fixed the statistic as Σᵢd(L(p,A),i); for p≤80 the length-three set has 98 pairs (36 QR, 62 QNR), with mean sums 139/4 and 990/31 respectively. The q=1 closed-form base passed 129 checks, but this small sample gives no robust sign-conditioned selector.

summary: The natural word is n/A=[[v,t,u]], A=tu−1; direct exact Dedekind sums verified the closed formula for 759 triples with n≤150, with zero mismatches. DEDEKIND_ES §2 already gives the decisive identity: “12 s(A,n) = Σᵢ(bᵢ−3) + (A + A*)/n”; this covers the requested reciprocity derivation.
not_done: No separate symbolic derivation beyond the cited identity.
next: Use the existing formula; it determines the alternating CF statistic, not the full word count.

For all 604 units A over primes p≡1 (mod 4), p≤101, its phase matched (A/p) with zero mismatches, as expected from the Gauss-sum identity; this does not establish a WRT phase or the L₃(p) sum.

For a=2,…,100, the reduced one-vertex determinant |a+1| agreed with the original absolute determinant in all 99 cases; this confirms boundary-determinant preservation, not the repo transport law.
